name: Take Back
summary: Inbox rows that morph into a stacked undo toast with a countdown ring, and fly back on Undo
about: Take Back is a delete-with-undo pattern for inboxes and lists. A deleted row tints red, collapses, and a copy of it arcs down and morphs into a dark toast with a five-second countdown ring. Undo sends the toast flying back into its exact row; if time runs out the toast squeezes to a dot and pops. Several deletes stack, and hovering the stack fans it out and pauses every timer.
how: Hover a message (or Tab to it) and press its bin button.
The row tints red, collapses, and its copy arcs down and becomes a toast with a 5-second ring.
Press Undo, or Ctrl+Z for the newest one, and the toast flies back into its row with a glow.
Hover or focus the toasts to fan them out and pause the countdown; when it ends the toast pops.
Delete all five for Inbox zero, then press Refill inbox.
